# Real room fixture

`living-room.jpg` is an actual photograph from WorldBuilder's official living-room demo, credited upstream to **Spacejoy on Unsplash**:

- Photograph: https://adamrolander.github.io/worldbuilder-demo/assets/living-room-photo.jpg
- Corresponding scene: https://adamrolander.github.io/worldbuilder-demo/living-room/
- Upstream credits: https://github.com/AdamRolander/WorldBuilder#examples
- Photograph license: https://unsplash.com/license

Downloaded 2026-11-25 for real-image upload and guided-projection acceptance tests. It is not synthetic placeholder data. The separate genuine reconstructed GLB is downloaded into ignored `test-results/` by `scripts/fetch_test_scene.py`, and is never a replacement result for uploaded images. StageAI does not claim to have generated that GLB.
